out.explanation: Statement A on page 131 refers specifically to 'fund based outstanding borrowings' (₹88.85 million), whereas Statement B on page 364 includes fund-based borrowings, non-fund-based borrowings (₹410.63 million), and unsecured loans (₹10.19 million) to arrive at a total borrowing figure of ₹509.67 million. These represent different components and scopes of the company's total borrowings rather than inconsistent statements of the same item.
